name: svg-editor-cli
description: A transactional, object-oriented SVG editor for Lab1 Phase 1

scripts.test: npm run build --silent && node --test dist/test/*.test.js && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build --silent && node --experimental-test-coverage --test dist/test/*.test.js && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify:visual: npm run build --silent && node scripts/verify-visual.mjs && node apps/dsh-plugin/verification/visual.mjs && node apps/dsh-plugin/verification/connector-audit.mjs && node apps/dsh-plugin/verification/caption-audit.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern apps packages plugins src test scripts doc ci .github README.md AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern apps packages plugins src test scripts doc ci .github README.md AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:docs && npm test && node scripts/replay-baseline.mjs && npm run check:architecture
